verdict.rationale: The SDK example `client.parsing.parse(..., tier="agentic")` returns a result directly, which suggests a blocking synchronous call and selectable tiers. The webhook docs, however, frame jobs as asynchronous work that is polled or notified on completion. Nothing in the pack shows results returning in seconds or latency documented for any tier. missing for 10: a documented fast/low-latency synchronous mode, per-mode or per-tier latency figures, independent or hands-on latency measurements.
